text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとヤ・シュトラは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and she are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Y’shtola are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとヤ・シュトラは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and she have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Y’shtola are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield her power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いにしえの知識を追い求めるうちに
争い乱れる世界の現実を知ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: In your pursuit of ancient and arcane knowledge, were you to become privy to the reality of your world—and to the extent of the tumult within it—what would you do?
text.real_en: If, while seeking ancient knowledge, you learned the reality of a world torn by conflict, what would you do?

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれど彼女は光を失っても
探求心はなくさなかったのです。
text.official_en: However, while Y’shtola may have lost her sight, her inquisitive mind was as sharp as ever.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
しかし、たがいに譲れぬ願いを抱えていると知り
迷いを捨てて、戦いを選んだのです。
text.official_en: In the end, however, it did little good. As neither side would bend, the Scions were forced to break their opponents.
text.real_en: But when they understood that neither side could give up its hopes, they cast aside their doubts and chose to fight.

text.jp:
それでも敗者を忘れず、覚えておく……。
記憶をつなぐことも、人のつとめでしょう。
text.official_en: Yet you would not forget those whom you laid low in the process, thus preserving their lives in some form as well.
text.real_en: And yet you would remember the defeated rather than forget them. Passing on memories is also part of being human.

text.jp: それは、終焉を越えて新生した異界の記憶――
text.official_en: For this world, the end came and went—after which all was born anew.
text.real_en: A memory of another world reborn beyond its own end...

text.jp:
ただ彼女たちが示したのは、
手を汚すことを辞さない覚悟でした。
text.official_en: Y’shtola, however, displayed a different sort of resolve: to triumph no matter the means.
text.real_en: What she and her companions showed, however, was the resolve to act even if it meant getting blood on their hands.

text.jp:
ところが国の陰謀に巻き込まれ
彼女たちは追われる身に。
text.official_en: At one point, the Scions fell victim to a conspiracy and were forced to flee as fugitives.

text.jp: ともに行動する仲間をつくる
text.official_en: Recruit others to aid you in your mission.
text.real_en: Find companions to act alongside you.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
ひとりでは抗えない現実にも
仲間がいれば立ち向かえる。
text.official_en: With others by one’s side, nearly every obstacle becomes much simpler to surmount.
text.real_en: Even when you cannot face reality alone, you may be able to confront it with companions.

text.jp: まず目の前の人々を救う
text.official_en: For now, save those who you can.
text.real_en: First, save the people right in front of you.

text.jp:
やがて彼女たちは、偉大な文明が栄えた
過ぎ去りし世界と対峙します。
text.official_en: They would eventually be faced with the shadows of a great civilization, of a sundered world that no longer was.
text.real_en: Eventually, they confronted a world long past, where a great civilization had flourished.

text.jp:
クリスタルの恵みに彩られ、
神々に愛されし地、エオルゼア。
text.official_en: The tale takes place in Eorzea, a realm embraced by the gods and blessed by the light of the Crystal.
text.real_en: Eorzea, a land blessed by the Crystal and loved by the gods.

text.jp:
ヤ・シュトラの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: Her thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Y’shtola’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
他者を滅ぼすぐらいなら、自分が滅ぶ。
それもまた、ひとつの覚悟です。
text.official_en: Rather than bring ruin unto others, you would bring it unto yourself—a decision requiring much courage.

text.jp:
仲間の足手まといにならないよう
身を引くのも、立派な決断です。
text.official_en: Should your presence truly be but a detriment, then the decision to step back would be a sage one.

text.jp:
仲間を助ける魔法を発動して
視力を失ってしまったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to cast a spell to save the lives of your companions, but it resulted in the loss of your eyesight, what would you do?

text.jp: 仲間を救えたなら満足
text.official_en: Take comfort in the fact your companions are safe.

text.jp:
信じれば仲間こそが光となって
導いてくれるでしょう。
text.official_en: Though your world may be shrouded in darkness, your allies shall act as a guiding light.
text.real_en: If you trust them, your companions will become a light to guide you.

text.jp: 全力で戦い、覚えておく
text.official_en: Honor your opponents’ memory after triumphing over them.
text.real_en: Fight with everything you have, and remember them.

text.jp:
彼女の名は、ヤ・シュトラ……。
あなたの想いが、彼女との絆になる。
text.official_en: That Archon’s name was Y’shtola, and it is with her you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: Her name was Y’shtola... Your feelings will form a bond with her.

text.jp:
彼女はエオルゼアの救済をめざす組織
暁の血盟に加わりました。
text.official_en: Y’shtola, too, sought the aid of others, and for her, it came in the form of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
text.real_en: She joined the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, an organization seeking to save Eorzea.

text.jp:
彼女は人々を混乱から救おうと
行動する道を選びました。
text.official_en: Similarly, Y’shtola elected to deliver people from chaos rather than allow them to suffer.

text.jp:
彼女も、賢人の知恵を活かして
世界の真相に向き合いました。
text.official_en: In a similar fashion, Y’shtola’s wisdom took center stage in her quest to confront the truth.
text.real_en: She too used her knowledge as an Archon to confront the truth of the world.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp: 戦いから身を引く
text.official_en: Stop fighting for the cause.

text.jp:
戦いを避ける可能性をさぐるのですね。
彼女たちも相手を理解しようと試みました。
text.official_en: You aim to gauge the possibility of a peaceful settlement; Y’shtola and her companions employed a similar stratagem.

text.jp:
新しい感覚をつかむ……難題ですが
これまでの知識や経験が支えになります。
text.official_en: Discovering a new method by which to perceive the world may prove difficult, but your knowledge and experience will be of great aid.

text.jp: 新たな感覚を身につける
text.official_en: Substitute sight with another sense.
text.real_en: Learn to perceive the world through other senses.

text.jp:
新生を遂げた異界の幻影　ヤ・シュトラ
光を失ってなお、その探求心が尽きることはない。
text.official_en:
Assiduous Intellectual Y’shtola
The woman whose inquisitive mind shines bright even when all is dark.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision from a world reborn: Y’shtola. Even after losing her sight, her thirst for knowledge never fades.

text.jp:
旧き真なる世界を再生すれば
いまの世界は消えてしまう……。
text.official_en: Should said world become whole once more, that of the Scions would cease to exist.

text.jp: 消えてもいいと受け入れる
text.official_en: Accept that your world will perish.

text.jp:
滅びを拒み、戦って未来を勝ち取る。
それは生命をつなぐ営みです。
text.official_en: You wish to preserve life rather than aid in its destruction, and thus feel it is your duty to fight.
text.real_en: You would reject destruction and fight to win a future. That is how life is carried forward.

text.jp: 災いを防ぐ知恵を求める
text.official_en: Find a means by which to prevent calamity.
text.real_en: Seek the knowledge to prevent disaster.

text.jp:
現在と過去の世界が存亡をかけて対立し
敗者は、世界もろとも消える――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were the existence of your world to be in direct opposition with that of another—and for theirs to survive, yours must meet its ruin—what would you do?
text.real_en: If the worlds of the present and past were locked in a struggle for survival, with the loser vanishing along with their world, what would you do?

text.jp: 理解しようと努力する
text.official_en: Attempt to understand your opponents’ view.
text.real_en: Try to understand them.

text.jp:
生き残るために危険を冒した彼女は
大きな代償を負うのです。
text.official_en: To ensure the others’ safety, Y’shtola had no recourse but to risk her own—and it cost her dearly.
text.real_en: She took a great risk to survive, and paid a heavy price.

text.jp:
知識は人々を守る力になると
あなたは理解しているのですね。
text.official_en: You understand the value of knowledge, as well as the role it can play in curing a realm’s ills.
text.real_en: You understand that knowledge can give you the power to protect people.

text.jp:
自分が光を失おうとも
仲間が無事なら、悔いはない……。
text.official_en: For you, the loss of sight pales in comparison to the safety of your companions.
text.real_en: Even if you lose the light, you would have no regrets as long as your companions were safe...

text.jp:
苦しむ人を放ってはおけない。
そんな想いが情熱の源になります。
text.official_en: You are not one to ignore the suffering of others, and it is that compassion that shall fuel you in your endeavors.

text.jp:
賢人の修養を活かし、彼女は視覚に頼らず
世界を感じる力を身につけました。
text.official_en: Y’shtola was successful in a similar endeavor, as she gained the power to perceive aether in her surrounding environs.
text.real_en: Drawing on her training as an Archon, she learned to perceive the world without relying on sight.

text.jp:
魔法学の修養を積んだ彼女は
若くして賢人と称されています。
text.official_en: One of its inhabitants was granted the illustrious title of Archon at a young age for her command of magic.
text.real_en: Having trained in the study of magic, she was called an Archon while still young.
